Subject: Re: Demo — infra fit + rough econ

Thanks again for the demo this morning, Vanessa — Arun and I walked through the latency numbers and the embedding throughput and both looked good. A couple quick clarifying questions so we can get internal approval:

- We ran a quick back-of-envelope and think our monthly token demand will sit between 12M–18M tokens for phase 1 (mostly chat+ranking). Is that within the starter band you mentioned?
- What's a realistic $/1M token target at that volume if we sign a 12-month committed plan?
- We're an early-stage founder-led team; do you have a founders/startup starter credit or introductory discount we can apply while we ramp?

Can you send a short, line-item summary we can share with finance (tokens, committed discount %, monthly cost at 12M / 18M, and any free credits)? Appreciate it — Priya

Head of Platform, SparkleAI
priya@sparkleai.com

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Priya Sharma <priya@sparkleai.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo — infra fit + rough econ

Priya — great to hear it resonated. Thanks for the clear questions; I captured answers below and attached a simple estimate workbook. Short version up front:

- Starter band: 10M–25M tokens/mo (fits your 12–18M estimate)
- Target list $/1M at 12M: $620; at 18M: $540 (list pricing, no commit)
- 12-month committed discount (12mo commit, monthly invoicing): typically 15% off list at your band; multi-year can go deeper.
- Founders starter credit: we can offer a $15k onboarding credit for qualifying early-stage founders (applies within the first 3 months).

I've attached SparkleAI_usage_estimate.xlsx with a line-by-line calc (tab: monthly scenarios). Quick highlights from the sheet:
- 12M tokens @ list = $7,440/mo -> with 15% commit = $6,324/mo -> effective $/1M = $527
- 18M tokens @ list = $9,720/mo -> with 15% commit = $8,262/mo -> effective $/1M = $459
- If founders credit applies, first-month net spend would subtract the credit ($15k), which effectively reduces the ARR impact for the first quarter (see row labeled "Founders credit impact").

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben and I will draft a short SOW + pricing memo with the 12mo commit option and an alternative multi-year (2yr) band for you to share with Finance.
2) If you want the founders credit, send the investor/founder details we require (single slide with cap table + founder bios) and we can fast-track.
3) Shall we tentatively schedule a 30-minute pricing walkthrough with your finance person this Wed?

If that plan works I'll send the SOW draft today.

Thanks — Vanessa

Attachments: SparkleAI_usage_estimate.xlsx

--
Vanessa Ortiz

Looping in the quick pricing knobs we discussed with ops — putting numbers into the SOW draft now. A couple clarifications to lock the math:

- Committed discount tiers we typically apply: 10% @ 6–12M, 15% @ 12–25M, 22% @ 25–75M (annual token commit equivalents). For SparkleAI at 12–18M the 15% tier is the right anchor.
- For multi-year: standard approach is 10% additional discount on top of the committed discount for a 2-year upfront minimum, or we can do step-downs tied to MAU milestones.
- Founders credit: underwriting needs one investor slide + a one-paragraph founder statement; legal requires a simple Acknowledgement Form (I’ll attach).

I attached a short pricing memo and a redlineable SOW template. Vanessa — if you want I can propose two price points in the SOW: (A) 12mo commit @ 15% (B) 24mo commit @ 25% (10% extra for multi-year). Priya — which of those would you prefer to share with Finance?

Attachments: Redwood_pricing_memo.pdf; SOW_template_redline.docx

--
Ben Carter
Director, Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
